text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pneumonia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The symptoms you describe—persistent restlessness, fidgeting, and pacing—are classic signs of akathisia, a common side effect of risperidone. However, I notice a doctor suggested this might be pneumonia; can you clarify what specific signs of infection, such as fever or a cough, you are experiencing, and were any lung imaging performed?

text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Akathisia secondary to Risperidone. The symptoms of restlessness, fidgeting, and pacing are consistent with this common side effect, and the recent diagnosis of pneumonia appears to be a misinterpretation of these motor symptoms rather than an actual infection.
